PERSONAL TRAINING

Personal Training

Become physically stronger. Develop a more conscious relationship with yourself.

Build strength and endurance, develop coordination and mobility.

Does a busy everyday life leave too little room for movement and recovery? Would you like to start again after a longer break? Are you unsure about exercises or training load?

We adapt training to your goals, experience and everyday life. Together we practise suitable movements, pay attention to how your body feels and discuss training load and recovery.

I explain and demonstrate the movement, observe your technique and give specific feedback. Together we adapt range of motion, resistance, pace and breaks to your training level, how you feel that day and your feedback.

Solo: 80 € · 60 minutes. Duo: 60 € per person · 120 € total · 60 minutes together.

My Private Gym, Plinganserstraße 132, 81369 München (Obersendling/Thalkirchen); then by the Isar / outdoors or at home — by personal arrangement.

Your concerns and suitable exercises

If you wish, we can focus on yoga or self-defence.

Do you start out motivated — and lose track after a short time?

We find a manageable starting point. If you wish, we choose additional exercises for home or everyday life, even when the week does not go as planned.

Do you have goals but feel unsure which exercises and training load suit you?

Do you already want to train again even though you do not feel recovered yet?

We take exertion, breathing and how your body feels into account. Together we explore when a challenge fits and when a break is appropriate.

Does training feel like just another obligation?

We look for activities that leave room for play, ambition and ease. Together we find out which tasks suit you and adapt them to you.

Do you tense up unnecessarily during a task, hold your breath or become rushed?

We try an appropriate focus, a change in technique or a break. Body awareness and suitable breathing exercises complement movement.

Working together and everyday practice

One possible 60-minute session

As a guide: about 10 minutes to arrive, 40 minutes of training and 10 minutes to wind down. We adapt the balance together.

Your training rhythm

We adapt how often we train together to your goals, training level and everyday life. If you wish, we choose additional exercises for between sessions.

We discuss what is manageable and adapt the plan as needed.

If needed, we can add support by phone or video call. We agree on the scope and arrangements personally in advance.

We discuss which questions and tasks are suitable for support by phone or video call.

Constant stress – always tense?

Is it hard to settle down after training or a busy day?

We try a comfortable breathing exercise and pay attention to how you feel. If you wish, we add HRV biofeedback: a chest strap records your heartbeats and we look at the feedback on screen. Together we discuss what you notice during the exercise.

Heart rate variability (HRV) describes differences in the time intervals between heartbeats. Your pulse counts heartbeats per minute. Blood pressure describes the pressure in your blood vessels. These are different measurements.

Separately, repeated measurements at rest can show your personal trend over several days. We consider them alongside sleep, training load, recovery and how your body feels, and discuss how this information relates to your training week.

If you have health-related limitations, we take medical guidance into account. If symptoms are new or worsening, we stop and clarify how to proceed.

SPORT PSYCHOLOGY COACHING

Sport psychology coaching

Find your direction. Develop confidence. Put your abilities into action.

Something on your mind?

Sport psychology support: we clarify your starting point and concerns, choose suitable tools and exercises and practise them together. With your feedback, we develop a personal plan for training, everyday life or your next performance situation.

We look at the words you say to yourself and how you say them. We explore your state of mind alongside practical steps. Together we develop and try new patterns and routines.

Ask about sport psychology coaching ↗

Philipp@achten.pro

Opens your email app. You review and send the message yourself.

Your concerns and how we work together

An injury or a break from sport?Together we explore how to deal with the changed situation, clarify realistic goals and focus on what you can influence now. Medical guidance remains the basis.

Are you missing a sense of direction or confidence in your body after an injury or break from sport?

After an injury, do you miss more than movement — your outlet, daily structure or sense of belonging? Do you wonder what remains of your sporting identity? Do frustration, impatience or worries about the future take up a lot of space?

We clarify what matters to you about sport and what can still have a place now: connection with others, daily structure or achievable personal goals. We explore frustration and repetitive thoughts, then choose a next step that suits your situation and limits.

Return to sport and develop confidenceTogether we clarify what makes you uncertain and choose suitable mental exercises, such as mentally preparing a movement or trying helpful self-talk.

Do doubts or fear of another injury hold you back when returning to sport?

What makes you uncertain about returning, and what physical activity is already permitted? We clarify your concerns and choose suitable mental exercises. For example, you might mentally prepare an upcoming movement or find words that support your return. Together we try what suits your situation.

Medical guidance applies to the physical return to sport. If exercise is medically prohibited, we do not add physical training load.

A competition, exam or important performance situation?Together we choose what you would like to work on and try suitable exercises for your preparation and focus.

Do your thoughts circle around the result, possible mistakes, fear of failure or how others might judge you — rather than your next action? Do you then struggle to show what you have practised?

Together we try personal preparation, helpful self-talk and a brief focus on the next action you can influence. Relevant information from outside remains part of the task.

For example, before returning to sport you might choose to examine a thought such as “I must be able to do everything again straight away”, try different self-talk and choose a suitable first step.

Notice your state and find the right level of activation

Do you become restless in important moments, or struggle to get going?

Together we choose and try breathing, movement, attention and other self-regulation exercises. You practise noticing your activation level — how tense, alert or ready you feel — and influencing it to suit the situation.

Depending on the situation, the aim may be to settle down or get going.

Respond flexibly to setbacks

Do mistakes, setbacks or unexpected changes throw you off balance?

We take your boundaries, suitable breaks and helpful support into account as you work on confidence and resilience.

Constant stress – always tense?

Do stress and tension linger?

Is the day or training session over, but your mind and body remain tense? We begin with a guided, comfortable breathing exercise and your own perception.

If you wish, we add HRV biofeedback: a chest strap records your heartbeats and we look at the feedback on screen together. We discuss what you notice and how the exercise suits you.

Heart rate variability (HRV) describes differences in the time intervals between heartbeats. Your pulse counts heartbeats per minute. Blood pressure describes the pressure in your blood vessels. These are different measurements.

Separately, if relevant, we look at repeated resting measurements over several days alongside sleep, training load, recovery and how your body feels. Together we discuss what you would like to observe more closely in your everyday life.

Practice between sessions

We discuss together how often support would be useful. If needed, we add a phone or video call; we agree on the scope and arrangements in advance.

We choose exercises to suit your concerns and try them together. If you wish, we agree on small routines for between sessions. Your experiences help us adapt the exercises. Joy, ease and ambition have a place here.
